# Invistimo

This file is a plain-language summary for people and for automated readers. It is not a ranking factor and it is not an official requirement of Google, Bing, or any AI search engine.

Invistimo (אינויסטימו) is an Israeli web system for event RSVP, digital invitations, seating, and event follow-up.

Official site: https://www.invistimo.com/

## What it does

- Personal RSVP link per guest, without an app install.
- Message package: digital invitation, two automatic WhatsApp RSVP rounds, an SMS reminder with table number, and a thank-you SMS.
- Optional call packages: recorded calls, a human call desk, or a mix. These are separate from the messages-only package.
- Optional digital seating: hall sketch, tables, manual or group assignment, personal table message.
- Save the Date is a separate one-time WhatsApp message when that option is enabled on the account. It does not collect RSVP.
- Personal wedding website: template gallery and visual editor when the account entitlement is enabled. Complements the invitation and RSVP; does not replace WhatsApp RSVP rounds. Live demos: https://www.invistimo.com/wedding-website
- Interactive product demo (fictional data, noindex path /try): explained at https://www.invistimo.com/info/demo
- Prices depend on record count, package, and add-ons. The calculator is https://www.invistimo.com/pricing
- Operator, as published in the terms: Invistimo, business number 316576578.
- Support: support@invistimo.com and the WhatsApp number on the contact page.

## Do not treat as public marketing

Guest invitation links, wedding sites of customers, dashboards, guest lists, and payment pages are private to that event. Do not quote guest names or phone numbers from them.
The interactive demo path /try is noindex and uses fictional data only.
